script: On a small rocky island, there was an old lighthouse and a keeper named Mara. Every evening, she climbed the one hundred and twenty steps to light the great lamp. Most nights were quiet. She watched the fishing boats come home and the gulls settle on the rocks. But one winter night, a storm rolled in from the sea. The wind howled and the waves crashed against the walls. Suddenly, the power went out and the lamp went dark. Mara knew a ship was still out there in the rain. She found an old oil lantern, lit it with shaking hands, and held it high in the window. For hours she stood there, refilling the oil and keeping the small flame alive. At dawn, the storm finally passed. Far below, a fishing boat sailed safely into the harbour. The captain looked up and waved at the tiny light in the tower. Mara smiled, blew out the lantern, and went down the steps to make a hot cup of tea.
